items.detail_en: Two questions: 1) What is your philosophy of education? 2) Why do international connections and English learning matter so much for students in Dacun?
items.detail_zh: 兩個問題：一、校長的教育理念；二、為何國際連結與英語教育對大村國中的學生很重要？
items.note_en: For the Voices in Education series.
items.note_zh: 收錄於「教育之聲」專訪系列。

items.detail_en: Break time. Test the projector, sound, and slides.
items.detail_zh: 下課時間。測試投影、音響與簡報。

items.detail_en: Period 6. What self-discipline is, 1% better every day, the Marshmallow Test, Dacun's grape farmers, the school's track and cycling teams, an If–Then plan, and a Freeze Challenge.
items.detail_zh: 第六節。什麼是自律、每天進步 1%、棉花糖實驗、大村的葡萄農、學校的田徑與自由車隊、「如果……就……」計畫，以及木頭人挑戰。

items.detail_en: Period 7. The same lesson as Class 804.
items.detail_zh: 第七節。與八〇四班同一套課程。

footnote_en: The school chose self-discipline as the topic. Both classes use the same deck. The visit ends around 4:20 p.m.
footnote_zh: 講題由學校指定：自律。兩班用同一套簡報。約 16:20 結束。
